description: Use this when the user wants to know which vets, nurses or assistants a Veterical clinic has, or needs their ids to book with one. Returns up to 100 staff with id and display name for one clinic (no contact details, roles or pet data). Not for staff days off or vacations.
name: list_clinic_providers

providers.description: Staff with a doctor, nurse or assistant role. Contact details, roles, colors, avatars and all animal or clinical data are excluded.

id.description: Staff id, for the providerIds of book_appointment

title: List bookable vets and staff
